services.title: Business websites
services.description: Fast, mobile-friendly websites built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, with clear service pages, contact forms and the SEO basics set up from day one.

services.title: Real estate and property websites
services.description: Property listing pages, location pages, legal-document highlights, lead-capture forms and an admin panel to export each day's leads. I have built these for LandCity Properties, Prime Properties JD, Space Realtors and Kshemrealty.

services.title: Booking and enquiry systems
services.description: Appointment booking, enquiry management and Excel exports for service businesses, plus internal tools such as a meeting management app with roles, agendas and scheduling.

services.title: WhatsApp and payment integrations
services.description: Meta WhatsApp Business API for notifications and customer messages, and Razorpay or PhonePe for online payments. I have run these in production for a healthcare platform with 500+ doctors.

services.title: Google and AI search visibility
services.description: Server-rendered pages, structured data, sitemaps, robots.txt and llms.txt, so your site can be read by Google and by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity.

services.title: Custom web apps and AI features
services.description: Dashboards, admin panels and LLM-powered features such as document summarization, built with React, Node.js and AWS.

process.title: Tell me about your project
process.description: Email me what your business does and what you need. We then have a short call to go through your goals, pages and features.

process.title: Get a written scope and quote
process.description: I send a written scope, timeline and price before any work starts, so you know exactly what you are getting.

process.title: Review as it is built
process.description: You get a live preview link while I build, so you can review pages and ask for changes along the way.

process.title: Launch
process.description: I connect your domain, deploy the site, and set up the sitemap and analytics so it is ready for visitors and search engines.

faq.question: How much does a website cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the number of pages and features you need. After a short call, I send a written quote with a fixed scope and timeline before any work starts, so there are no surprises.

faq.question: What kind of businesses have you built websites for?
faq.answer: I have built websites and web apps for real estate firms, an accounting and compliance firm, a performance marketing agency, a vehicle service center and a hospital. You can see the client projects on this page.

faq.question: Will my website show up on Google?
faq.answer: Every site I build is server-rendered, fast and mobile-friendly, with page titles, descriptions, structured data and a sitemap set up, which is what search engines need to read it. Your ranking also depends on your content and competition, so no one can honestly guarantee a position.

faq.question: What technology do you use?
faq.answer: For most business websites I use Next.js and Tailwind CSS. For web apps I use React, Node.js, MySQL or PostgreSQL, and AWS. I choose the simplest setup that does the job well.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Email me at vnikhil3101@gmail.com with a few lines about your business and what you need. I will reply to set up a short call.
